items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Because I played with Thad’s Ball of Fire big band in Europe in ’83

ctx.x: I said oh man, how nice. Because I played with Thad’s Ball of Fire big band in Europe in ’83, we did a concert and a bunch of recordings, and he was part of “More Blues and the Abstract Truth.”

That’s great company. You’ve had kind of the cream on a lot of your projects. And you know it’s a long way from Anton Webern to Tom Scott and Joni Mitchell. You really kind of have this huge attention span and curiosity I guess.
